phases.name: Slice 01 — Calm entry theme: shared stylesheet, entry + door, light + dark (US-008)

steps.name: Walking skeleton: theme.css ships with the app shell (entry screen, both schemes)
steps.description: Create web/static/theme.css (CUBE-lite, full DDD-4 token set incl. --chart-*), link it from index.html, and — same commit, binding Forge condition — append /static/theme.css to sw.js APP_SHELL, bump SHELL_CACHE weight-tracker-shell-v1 -> -v2, align PWA_MANIFEST colors to #FAFAF8/#1A1A1A.
criteria: GET / HTML references /static/theme.css; GET /static/theme.css serves the stylesheet (light :root tokens + prefers-color-scheme dark override) with real FS I/O
Entry screen wears the calm theme in both appearances and stays ready for immediate typing (autofocus + decimal keypad intact)
sw.js APP_SHELL includes /static/theme.css AND SHELL_CACHE is bumped to -v2 in this same step/commit (Forge condition 1)
All milestone 1-6 acceptance tests stay green, unmodified
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-007: hand-written token stylesheet, CUBE-lite layer order Tokens -> Global -> Composition (one flow primitive) -> Utility (deliberately empty) -> Block (id/element-keyed, zero new classes) -> Exception (aria-pressed/hidden/:focus-visible). Token hexes from the DDD-4 table in feature-delta (G-4 contract); ship the FULL set including --chart-* now — the contrast scenarios (01-03) examine the whole palette. Zero new entry-screen JS (D-9 pin). routes.py delta bounded to PWA_MANIFEST color fields; Q4 (per-scheme meta theme-color vs single value) is the crafter's call here. WS scenario is already unskipped (RED live); unskip nothing else — @pending discipline: each step unskips ONLY its own scenarios. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: ships CSS/template/manifest data, no new Python logic; compensated by property-based contrast/parity checks at acceptance level (scenarios 8-9 exercise the full token universe in 01-03).
steps.scenario_name: The calm look arrives with the morning screen

steps.name: The door wears the theme; morning flows provably invariant
steps.description: Theme the door (migrate + delete its inline <style>; 44 px rule goes global) and prove zero behavior change on the themed entry screen: entry-speed property, save confirmation + glance refresh, rejection preservation, wrong-passphrase refusal. Unskip scenarios 2-6 one at a time.
criteria: Locked HTML navigation shows the door wearing the calm theme; every control >= 44 px touch target (door inline <style> deleted, rule global in theme.css)
Themed entry screen is interactive within two seconds with the glance shown (@property scenario)
A valid save confirms, refreshes the glance in place, and stores exactly one entry — byte-for-byte as before (bounded-change)
A rejected save (824) is refused with the 30.0-250.0 message, stores nothing, keeps the typed value (unbounded-preservation)
A wrong passphrase at the themed door is visibly rejected and the record stays hidden
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-007 Block/Exception layers: door hooks are existing ids/elements (#door-rejection etc.) — no new classes; 44 px promoted to Global (input, button { min-height: 44px }). No GET /login route exists — the access middleware answers locked navigation with the door page (DISTILL driving-adapter note). Invariance scenarios assert existing contracts (#save-feedback, #trend-glance, POST /entries semantics) with the theme on — expected GREEN work is styling only; if any flips behavior, that is a defect in this step. @pending discipline: unskip only scenarios 2-6. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: CSS/template only; scenario 2 is the DISTILL-authored @property coverage for this surface, and rejection invariance rides the inherited milestone-1 closed rejection set (completeness audit C6c).
steps.scenario_name: The new clothes never slow the morning down; A save lands exactly as it always has; A rejected save is turned away exactly as before; The door wears the same clothes; A wrong passphrase is refused as plainly as ever at the themed door

steps.name: Theme contract guardrails: contrast, dark parity, byte budget, progressive enhancement
steps.description: Green the theme's own contract: WCAG ratios in both schemes (G-4), dark block answering every light token, <= 10 KB / zero-external / zero-entry-JS budget (G-5), and the missing-theme degradation. Nudge hexes, complete dark parity, and trim bytes in theme.css as the checker demands.
criteria: Every text pairing >= 4.5:1 and every non-text pairing >= 3:1 in BOTH schemes per CONTRAST_CONTRACT (ratios pinned, never hexes — one-hex-step nudges stay green)
The dark override block declares every custom property the light block names (no accidental daylight fallback in dim light)
Total theme weighs <= 10 KB uncompressed; no request leaves the app's origin; the entry screen carries no new scripts
With theme.css absent, a save still completes end-to-end and the entry screen opens ready for typing (unstyled but functional)
steps.implementation_notes: The AT-side WCAG relative-luminance checker (domain_types.py, pure functions) is the authoritative G-4 instrument (DISTILL Q1/Q6 resolution); tightest pair is light --chart-grid ~3.3:1 — expect at most one-hex-step shifts, keep the DDD-4 ratio floors. Gridline strictness stays 3:1 (Q2); relaxing requires editing CONTRAST_CONTRACT with a wave-decision note. Missing-theme runs through the tolerant client (raise_server_exceptions=False): absence must surface as unstyled degradation, never a 500 — index.html changes only if degradation demands. @pending discipline: unskip only scenarios 8-11. Slice 01 DoD after this step: deploy + dogfood (theme.css on first visit, old -v1 cache evicted — Forge condition 1c; real morning log). EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: contract is golden asset structure + WCAG arithmetic already property-framed in the acceptance checker; no new Python units.
steps.scenario_name: Ink and surface keep their contrast promise in any light; Dim light is never served the daylight palette by accident; The finished look costs almost nothing; A missing theme never blocks the morning weigh-in

phases.name: Slice 02 — Graph theme: controls + chart from the single palette (US-009)

steps.name: Graph dresses from the single palette; pressed state beyond color
steps.description: Theme graph.html from theme.css: link the stylesheet, migrate + delete the inline <style>, replace hard-coded chart hexes with --chart-* token reads, add the matchMedia scheme listener re-rendering through the existing showGraph. Chart behavior (windowing, gaps, lens/scale semantics) untouched.
criteria: GET /graph wears the calm theme; its inline <style> is gone (rules folded into theme.css)
aria-pressed controls are distinguishable by fill/weight/shape, not color alone, in both schemes; aria-pressed and data-view/data-scale contracts unchanged
Chart axis, gridline, and both series strokes come solely from the --chart-* tokens (no hard-coded #1f6feb/#d29922); raw gaps still render as gaps
A mid-session scheme flip re-themes page and chart without losing the selected lens and time scale (AT asserts single-palette structure; live flip = dogfood)
Graph interactive <= 2 s; all existing graph acceptance tests green, unmodified
steps.implementation_notes: ADR-007 decision 3: renderChart reads --chart-axis/--chart-grid/--chart-raw/--chart-trend via getComputedStyle at build time; one matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') change listener calls the existing showGraph(page.dataset.scale) — lens + scale preserved by construction; ~8 lines JS, graph page only; vendored uPlot files stay byte-identical. Deps on 01-03: consumes token values as finalized by the contrast checker. Underline/bold pressed style superseded by the Exception-layer fill treatment. @pending discipline: unskip only scenario 7. DoD before sign-off: live-flip dogfood (open graph, toggle OS dark mode) — TestClient cannot drive matchMedia (DISTILL dogfood note); then confirm mutation-testing scope (~nil, templates/CSS) per feature-delta pre-requisites. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: template/CSS plus browser-side scheme wiring not reachable by Python unit tests; compensated by the single-palette structural assertions (scenarios 7-9) over the full token universe.
steps.scenario_name: The graph dresses from the same palette
